en-US.name: Steady Noise Premium
en-US.description: Adds pink and brown noise to Steady Noise. Pink is softer, like steady rain; brown is deeper, like a distant waterfall. Both play all night or on a timer.

customProductPrompts.purchasePromptDescription: Steady Noise Premium adds pink and brown noise and plays any color all night.
customProductPrompts.boughtCardDescription: You now have Steady Noise Premium: white, pink, and brown noise.

inSkillProductDefinition.testingInstructions: Ask for pink or brown noise, or say 'buy premium'. Premium unlocks pink and brown. White noise is free with no time limit.
